text.jp:
―おとぎの国から帰還した男の話―

ミシディアという名前を聞いたことくらいはあるだろうか？
どこにあるかわからない、おとぎの国である。

先日、船で遭難した男性が無事に戻ってきたので取材したのだが
話を聞くと、どうもミシディアの人に助けられたようである。

記憶に混乱が見られ、夢でも見ていたのかもしれないが……

男が言うには、ミシディアではちょっとした事件が発生していたようだ。
死者が蘇り、ドッペルゲンガーが現れ、右へ左へのどんちゃん騒ぎ。
男を助けた魔道士は困っていたということだ。

しかし、夢にしては妙にリアルな夢である……やはりミシディアは実在するのか。
一つ明らかなことは、いかに困っていようと、夢の住人を助けることはできない。
もし、君が夢に入ることができるなら、助けにいってもいいかもしれない。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
The Man Who Came Back from a Fairy Tale

Have you heard of Mysidia? No one knows where it is located, but it’s said to be like something out of a fairy tale.

I interviewed a man who survived a shipwreck, and he claimed to have been saved by Mysidians.

His memory was spotty at best though, so perhaps it was but a dream.

But according to him, Mysidia is in something of a crisis: the dead are rising from their graves, and doppelgangers are appearing—a grim scene everywhere you look.

His descriptions were so vivid, it’s hard to write it off as mere fantasy. Perhaps Mysidia does exist in some dreamlike state. That said, there’s no way to rescue the inhabitants of a dream. Or is there...?

-Foxie
text.real_en:
The Man Who Came Back from a Fairy Tale

Have you heard of Mysidia? No one knows where it is located, but it’s said to be like something out of a fairy tale.

I interviewed a man who survived a shipwreck, and he claimed to have been saved by Mysidians.

His memory was spotty at best though, so perhaps it was but a dream.

But according to him, Mysidia is in something of a crisis: the dead have come back to life, doppelgangers have appeared, and the place is in an uproar. The mage who rescued him was apparently at a loss.

His descriptions were so vivid, it’s hard to write it off as mere fantasy. Could Mysidia really exist? One thing is clear: you can't help people living in a dream, no matter how troubled they are. If you could enter dreams yourself, perhaps you might go and help.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―お年寄り情報　皆様にご協力を―

先日よりガベラダの町に、外部から来たと思われるご老人がいらっしゃる。
この町を訪れる者が少ない上に、ご老人というのは本当に珍しいのである。

このご老人、東の高台の方に行きたがるのであるが、ご存じの通り
耐性のない者には到達できない場所である。

もしこのご老人が町をでて瘴気の方に行ってしまうのを見かけたら、
町に戻るようにご忠告いただけるよう、皆様の協力を願います。

自治会
text.official_en:
Help Keep an Old Man Safe

An elderly gentleman has made his way to Gaberada. This town gets few visitors, and hardly any are of advanced age.

The old man wants to visit the plateau to the east but faces an exceedingly difficult journey.

If you see him outside the village en route to the miasma, please warn him that he must return to town.

-Gaberada Town Council
text.real_en:
Help Keep an Old Man Safe

An elderly gentleman has made his way to Gaberada. This town gets few visitors, and hardly any are of advanced age.

The old man wants to visit the plateau to the east but as you know, that area cannot be reached without resistance to the miasma.

If you see him outside the village en route to the miasma, please warn him that he must return to town.

-Gaberada Town Council

text.jp:
―オルデリオンの不漁―

ポーションの主要な輸出先の一つであるオルデリオンで、
不穏な情報をキャッチした。

なんでも、稀に見る、不漁となっているようだ。
現地の漁師たちは水神様の怒りだと噂していた。

飛空艇が主流となった今でも、
海運の中心であるオルデリオンは世界経済の要である。

現地では、水の守り人を中心とした元老院が
解決に動き出しているようだが、守り人は昨今留守にしがちだ。

こちらでも金融的な支援は続けるが、誰かの手助けが必要かもしれない。

ポーションファンド代表
text.official_en:
Fish Shortage in Olderion

The catch of the day is some unfortunate news from Olderion, a key destination for potion exports.

In a rare turn, anglers across the region are reporting poor catches,
and they believe the God of Water’s wrath is the cause.

Even in the airship era, the marine merchants of Olderion are still a pillar of the global economy.

The council—including the Wardens of the Waters—are searching for a solution,
but the Wardens seem to be preoccupied as of late.

We will of course continue to send funds, but some more direct intervention may be in order.

-The Potion Fund
text.real_en:
—Poor Fishing in Olderion—

We've received troubling news from Olderion, one of the major export destinations for potions.

Apparently, fishing catches there have been unusually poor. Local fishermen say it's because the God of Water is angry.

Even with airships now the main means of transport, Olderion remains a center of maritime trade and a vital part of the world economy.

The council of elders, led by the Warden of Water, has begun looking for a solution, but the Warden has often been away lately.

We'll continue to offer financial support, but they may need someone to lend a hand.

—Potion Fund Representative

text.jp:
―グランシェルト・コロシアム再開！　挑戦者求む！―

王都グランシェルトにて、
コロシアムの運営が再開されたようだ。

これは騎士国家であるグランシェルト王国が
元々、騎士たちの武を問うために開催していたものだ。

今は身分問わず参加が可能となり、人気となった催しである。

主催者のグランシェルト王は
「腕に覚えのある者の参加を心待ちにしている」
とのこと。

なお、報酬には伝説の秘宝の一つ「大地のハンマー」も用意されているようだ。
我こそは、という者はぜひ、挑戦してみてほしい。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
Grandshelt Colosseum Reopens Its Gates!

The famed Grandshelt Colosseum has officially reopened.

It was first established as a proving ground for the fabled Knights of Grandshelt.
In the years following, its gates have been open to warriors of all backgrounds, transforming it into a celebrated venue for competitive combat.

“All who are confident in their martial prowess are welcome,” declared the king of Grandshelt.

In addition to glory and recognition, contenders can compete for a plethora of spectacular prizes—among them, the legendary Gaia Hammer.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
Grandshelt Colosseum Reopens! Challengers Wanted!

The Colosseum in the royal capital of Grandshelt has reopened.

The Kingdom of Grandshelt, a nation of knights, originally held the event to test its knights' skills.

Now people of any status can compete, and it has become a popular event.

The king of Grandshelt, who organizes the event, says he is looking forward to having those confident in their skills take part.

Prizes reportedly include the Earth Hammer, one of the legendary treasures. Anyone who fancies their chances should give it a try.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―グランシェルト砂漠に眠る者―

グランシェルト大陸はグランポート北東にある広大な砂漠。
荒野のただなかに、そびえ立つ巨石がある。

鎮め石と呼ばれるその巨石は、触れる者があれば
大きな地響きが起きると言われており、人呼んで「大地の怒り」。

このほど、調査の結果、内部になんらかのエネルギー体が
封じられていることが判明した。

巨石を破壊すれば、中に存在する何かに触れることができるが
誰もが「大地の怒り」を恐れ、調査は遅々として進まない。

さらに言えば、鎮め石は特殊な物質でできているようで、
通常の手段では破壊できないようだ。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
What Slumbers in the Grandshelt Desert?

The continent of Grandshelt is a vast desert spreading out in the northeast of Grandport,
and amid that desolation stands an enormous stone.

Known as the sealing stone, when touched, the land itself
shakes—a phenomenon locals call “Gaia’s Wrath.”
A survey has revealed that some manner of energy source is sealed within.

If the stone were broken open, it might be possible to access it.
But fear of Gaia’s Wrath has stymied such efforts.

What’s more, the sealing stone appears to be composed of a unique mineral,
unbreakable by normal means.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―グランポートに騎士団が立ち入り調査か―

グランシェルト騎士団が
港町グランポートに頻繁に出入りしているとの情報を得た。

何やらものものしい雰囲気で、毎日のように
聞き込みがなされているらしい。

ある筋からの情報によれば、王の密命での立ち入り調査とのことだが……。

調査を担当するシャルロット氏に取材を敢行したところ、黙秘とのこと。
とはいえ彼女は切羽詰まっていたようだった。

極秘任務とはいえ、彼女には助力が必要ではなかろうか。


記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
A Secret Mission?

We’ve received intel that the Knights of Grandshelt have been making frequent visits to Grandport.

Seemingly every day, they’ve been asking questions and making their presence felt.
Intel points to a series of surprise questionings, ordered covertly by the king.

The head of these questionings, Charlotte, exercised her right to remain silent when interviewed. That said, she was clearly at her wits’ end.

Her mission may remain a secret, but she surely could use some help.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
A Secret Mission?

We’ve received intel that the Knights of Grandshelt have been making frequent visits to Grandport.

Seemingly every day, they’ve been asking questions and making their presence felt.
One source claims the investigation is being carried out on the king's secret orders.

The head of these questionings, Charlotte, refused to comment when interviewed. That said, she was clearly at her wits’ end.

Her mission may remain a secret, but she surely could use some help.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―ゾルダード大火山に轟く声―

ゾルダード帝国領には、多くの火山がある。
その火山の一つから、雄たけびのような音が聞こえると噂されている。

ゾルダードに在住している私も、聞いたことがある。

とはいえ、火山の中で生存できる生物はいないだろう。

となれば、噴火の予兆か、あるいは地殻変動の影響か。

原因を調査するためには、飛空艇で火口に入るしかないが……
そんなことをしたら何が起きるかは、
まさに「火を見るよりも明らか」であろう。

声の正体を確かめるすべはないようである。残念だ。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
Volatile Volcano, Voluminous Voice

Many volcanoes can be found within the Zoldaad Empire. But in the vicinity of one in particular, a great roar can be heard.

As a resident of Zoldaad myself, I’ve experienced it firsthand.

Yet surely nothing can live within a volcano.

Could this be an omen of an impending eruption? A sign of seismic shifts?

To investigate further would, of course, require approach via airship—a fool’s errand if ever there was one.

Alas, the voice shall remain a mystery.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
Volatile Volcano, Voluminous Voice

Many volcanoes can be found within the Zoldaad Empire. But in the vicinity of one in particular, a great roar can be heard.

As a resident of Zoldaad myself, I’ve experienced it firsthand.

Yet surely nothing can live within a volcano.

Could this be an omen of an impending eruption? A sign of seismic shifts?

To investigate further would, of course, require flying an airship into the crater...and it's all too obvious what might happen if you did.

Alas, the voice shall remain a mystery.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―ディルマギア空路での突風にご注意を―

現在、ディルマギアの上空で気流が乱れており
飛空艇での運行に支障をきたしています。

各地よりディルマギアへ航行する際は、
高度を低めに取ることを推奨いたします。

また、本件の解決のために、腕に覚えのある飛空艇技師を探しています。
心当たりのある方は、ぜひディルマギアの造船所にきてください。

ディルマギア商会より
text.official_en:
Gale Force Winds over Dilmagia

We are currently experiencing volatile winds in Dilmagian airspace, which have been causing issues for airship flights in the region.

If traveling to Dilmagia from any direction, we recommend maintaining a low altitude to avoid turbulence.

Additionally, we are seeking a skilled airship mechanic to aid in relief efforts. Any interested parties should visit the Dilmagia shipyards.

-Dilmagia Chamber of Commerce
text.real_en:
Warning: Sudden Gusts on the Dilmagia Air Route

We are currently experiencing volatile winds in Dilmagian airspace, which have been causing issues for airship flights in the region.

If traveling to Dilmagia from any direction, we recommend maintaining a low altitude to avoid turbulence.

Additionally, we are seeking a skilled airship mechanic to help resolve the problem. Any interested parties should visit the Dilmagia shipyards.

-Dilmagia Chamber of Commerce

text.jp:
―ナシャトで調査員募集中―

グランシェルト王の命令で、コロボス大陸の地質調査を行います。

ただ……この大陸ほんとに広くて大変なんです。

クリスタルのことを調べたい！
地層から歴史とか知りたい！
王様に褒められたい！
クロエお姉ちゃんにも褒められたい！

そ～んなこと思ってる、そこのあなた！

かよわいクロエ博士にちょっと力貸してちょうだい！

広告主：クロエ博士
text.official_en:
Surveyors Sought in Felicitas

His Majesty the King of Grandshelt has ordered a geological survey of Kolobos.

The continent is huge, and time is of the essence.

Do you think crystals are neat? What about archaeology? Do you want the king to think you’re cool? Do you want Professor Chloe to think you’re cool?

If so, then I can use your help!

-Professor Chloe
text.real_en:
—Surveyors Wanted in Felicitas—

By order of the King of Grandshelt, we are conducting a geological survey of the Kolobos continent.

But... this continent is huge, and surveying it is no easy task.

Want to learn about the Crystals?
Want to uncover history through the earth's layers?
Want the king to praise you?
Want Chloe-oneechan to praise you, too?

If that sounds like you, then yes, you!
Give poor, delicate Professor Chloe a hand!

Advertiser: Professor Chloe

text.jp:
―一期一会の商船―

一期一会……それをまさに体現する商人がいる。

彼らは商船に乗り、港に寄ることなく世界の海を航海する。
そして、旅の中で巡り合った飛空艇とだけ、取引をするという。

扱う商品は掘り出し物だけ。
いずれも、貴重な品のようだ。

飛空艇を所持している読者諸氏は少ないとは思うが
もし所持しているならば、彼らとの出会いを楽しみに
空の旅に興じてもいいかもしれない。


記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
A Merchant Ship, A Chance Encounter

You never know who you’ll run into out there, and a certain merchant embodies that spirit.

He hauls his wares across the seas, never stopping in any port, and only trading with any airships he runs into along the way.

His goods are only what he’s picked up on his travels, yet each one is a treasure.
I imagine very few of my readers own their own airship, but if you do, keep your eyes peeled.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
A Merchant Ship, A Chance Encounter

You never know who you’ll run into out there, and there are merchants who embody that spirit.

They sail the world's seas without calling at ports, trading only with airships they happen to encounter.

They deal only in rare finds, and all their goods seem valuable.
I imagine very few of my readers own their own airship, but if you do, perhaps you could enjoy a journey through the skies in hopes of encountering them.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―世界に危機の兆候か？―

何者かの襲撃により、王都グランシェルトが大きな被害を受けたようだ。

土の神殿のクリスタルが破壊された、という噂さえある。
流石に、これは噂でしかないと信じたいが……現在神殿は封鎖されており、
確認はできなかった。

先日入った情報によれば、ディルナドの風の神殿でも
なにやら動きがあったとのことだ。

巨大な飛行戦艦が、飛び立つのを目撃したものもいる。
あの戦艦は、近年軍備増強が際立つゾルダード帝国に納品されるものなのだろうか？

あるいは、全く別の、何者かの思惑で動いているものか？

世界に大きな変革が訪れようとしているのかもしれない……。


記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
A Sign of the Times?

Grandshelt is in shambles after an attack by some unknown force.

Rumor has it the Crystal in the Earth Shrine was shattered.
With the shrine closed at present, I can neither confirm nor deny such horrors.

There have been similar rumblings about the Wind Shrine in Dirnado.

Some claim to have seen a gigantic airship lifting off from there.
Perhaps it was en route to the Zoldaad Empire, as part of their recent arms buildup.

Or perhaps these are the machinations of some other party.
The world stands on the brink, though of what I cannot yet say.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
A Sign of a Crisis Facing the World?

The royal capital of Grandshelt appears to have suffered heavy damage in an attack by an unknown force.

There are even rumors that the Crystal in the Earth Shrine was destroyed. I'd like to believe those are only rumors, but the shrine is closed off, so I couldn't check.

According to a recent report, something has also been happening at the Wind Shrine in Dirnado.

Some witnesses claim to have seen a gigantic flying battleship take off. Could it have been intended for delivery to the Zoldaad Empire, which has been conspicuously expanding its military in recent years?

Or could it be moving according to the plans of someone else entirely?

Perhaps great changes are coming to the world...

-Foxie

text.jp:
―吟遊詩人の奏でる歌―

名高い吟遊詩人のロイ氏が、ディルナドにて目撃されている。

吟遊詩人は各地を渡り歩き、訪れた地の物語や伝承をもとに
歌や詩を書き、吟じ奏でながら旅をつづけている。
言うなれば歌によって人々の想いを伝える旅人である。

もしも運良く吟遊詩人に出会い、その歌に耳を傾ければ
異国の神秘や未知なる伝説を知ることができるだろう。

取材によると、ロイ氏はディルナドの伝承を調べており、
ドワーフの工房に、ことのほか興味を示している模様。
新たな詩歌が生まれるのだろうか？
是非とも聞いてみたいものである。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
The Bard’s Song

The famed bard Roy has been sighted in Dirnado.

He wanders the land far and wide, turning local tales and legends into songs and poems, performing as he goes. You could say he’s a traveler who conveys people’s thoughts and feelings through song.

If you’re lucky enough to meet a talented bard, you may learn of the myths and mysteries of foreign lands.

Based on my digging, Roy is here looking into the folklore of Dirnado and is particularly interested in the Dwarven Forge. Could a new song be nigh? I for one cannot wait to hear it.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
The Bard’s Song

The famed bard Roy has been sighted in Dirnado.

He wanders the land far and wide, turning local tales and legends into songs and poems, performing as he goes. You could say he’s a traveler who conveys people’s thoughts and feelings through song.

If you’re lucky enough to meet a bard and listen to their songs, you may discover the mysteries of foreign lands and legends you’ve never heard before.

Based on my digging, Roy is here looking into the folklore of Dirnado and is particularly interested in the Dwarven Forge. Could a new song be nigh? I for one cannot wait to hear it.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―壊れゆくクリスタル―

大災禍を生き延びた男は静かに語った。

世界に存在する８つのクリスタル。それにまつわる伝説を。

クリスタル失われし時
災厄が訪れ
世界の安定は崩れ去るだろう。

今、各地のクリスタルが破壊されている。
これを止めなければ、世界に再び災厄が訪れるだろう。


巡礼者：ハモン
text.official_en:
Shattering Crystals

The survivor of the great calamity spoke in hushed tones of the eight Crystals in this world and the legend that surrounds them:

When the Crystals are no more, this world will be torn asunder.

Now, all across the world, the Crystals are shattering.

If this disturbing trend cannot be stopped, naught but ruin awaits.

-Hamon, a Pilgrim
text.real_en:
Shattering Crystals

The survivor of the great calamity spoke in hushed tones of the eight Crystals in this world and the legend that surrounds them:

If the Crystals are lost, disaster will come and the balance of the world will crumble.

Now, all across the world, the Crystals are shattering.

If we do not stop this, calamity will strike the world once again.

-Hamon, a Pilgrim

text.jp:
―将軍は本当に裏切ったのか？―

帝国の盾と呼ばれたゾルダードの軍人
「ヴィルヘルム将軍」が処刑されたことは記憶に新しい。

皇帝に反旗を翻したということで反逆罪に問われたものだが、
彼は本当に裏切ったのだろうか？

過去の取材によれば、ヴィルヘルム将軍はソゼ皇帝の無二の親友であり
若き日には、互いに背中を預けあった戦場がいくつもあったという。

まさに戦友とも呼べる彼らの絆が、果たしてそうも簡単に
ほつれてしまうものだろうか？

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
Is the General Truly a Traitor?

The execution of Zoldaad’s General Wilhelm, once known as
the Shield of the Empire, is still fresh in memory.

He was convicted of treason for staging an uprising against the emperor, but was he truly the traitor they say?

According to prior reporting, the general was Emperor Sozhe’s closest friend and confidant.
In their younger days, they fought side by side on many a battlefield.

Would such a man truly betray his brother-in-arms?

-Foxie
text.real_en:
Is the General Truly a Traitor?

The execution of Zoldaad’s General Wilhelm, once known as
the Shield of the Empire, is still fresh in memory.

He was convicted of treason for staging an uprising against the emperor, but was he truly the traitor they say?

According to prior reporting, the general was Emperor Sozhe’s closest friend and confidant.
In their younger days, they fought side by side on many a battlefield.

Could a bond between comrades-in-arms like theirs really unravel so easily?

-Foxie

text.jp:
―恐怖！　魔列車の汽笛が今日も鳴る―

ゾルダード帝国領の南部に廃駅がある。
数年前に大規模な事故が起こり、以来使われなくなった駅だ。

その廃駅で最近列車を目撃したという噂が、帝都の一部で流れ始めている。

誰もいない駅を、走ってないはずの列車が走っていく。

そんな怪談めいた話であるが、それが本当なら、
列車はどこからきてどこへ行くというのだろうか？

興味のある人は、帝都に行って
噂話に巡りあうのを楽しみに散策してもよいだろう。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
The Phantom Train’s Whistle of Woe!

In the southern reaches of the Zoldaad Empire stands a defunct train station, abandoned since a horrible accident of years past.

Yet rumors of trains leaving this abandoned station have begun to spread.

The station should be empty, and yet the trains keep running.

It may sound like a ghost story, but if so, where are the trains coming from? And where are they going?

If your interest is piqued, why not head south and investigate?

-Foxie
text.real_en:
The Phantom Train’s Whistle of Woe!

In the southern reaches of the Zoldaad Empire stands a defunct train station, abandoned since a horrible accident of years past.

Recently, rumors have spread through parts of the imperial capital that a train has been seen at this abandoned station.

A train that should no longer be running passes through an empty station.

It may sound like a ghost story, but if so, where are the trains coming from? And where are they going?

If you're curious, why not explore the imperial capital and see what rumors you can hear?

-Foxie

text.jp:
―港町にひろがる義賊への期待！―

王都グランシェルトでは復興作業が順調に進んでいるが
立て直しが遅れている部分があることも現実だ。

グランポートの町に暮らす人々への支援や物流がとどこおり、
苦しい暮らしを訴える声が、次第に大きくなりつつある。

そんな世相のせいか、とある噂が流れている。
３年前、悪徳商人から盗んだ財を恵まれない子供たちに配り
義賊と呼ばれた者がいた。
事件が未解決に終わったことで、人々の心に残ったようだ。

盗みは犯罪であるが、義賊の再来を期待してしまうほど
人々の苦しみは深いといえる。
一日も早い復興と生活の再建が待ち望まれる。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
“Noble Thief” Steals Port Town’s Heart

Though efforts to rebuild Grandshelt proceed swiftly, progress has lagged in certain areas.

Grandport in particular continues to struggle, to the dismay of its residents.
Amid the frustration, a rumor has circulated: three years ago a “noble thief” went on a spree of robberies, taking from corrupt merchants and giving to needy children. The crimes were never solved and the memory of the thief’s compassion lingered.

Stealing is a crime, to be sure, but who can blame a suffering populace if they yearn for the reappearance of this folk hero now? Hopefully a return to prosperity is on the horizon.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
“Noble Thief” Steals Port Town’s Heart

Though efforts to rebuild Grandshelt proceed swiftly, progress has lagged in certain areas.

Aid and the flow of goods to Grandport's residents have stalled, and more and more people are speaking out about their hardship.
Amid the frustration, a rumor has circulated: three years ago a “noble thief” went on a spree of robberies, taking from corrupt merchants and giving to needy children. The crimes were never solved and the memory of the thief’s compassion lingered.

Stealing is a crime, to be sure, but who can blame a suffering populace if they yearn for the reappearance of this folk hero now? Hopefully a return to prosperity is on the horizon.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―紅玉の洞窟にある石碑の謎―

オルデリオンから南下した山際にある「紅玉の洞窟」は、
美しい名とは裏腹に、めぼしい名物や産物もなく
これといって面白みのない場所である。

唯一興味を引くのは、洞窟に据えられた石碑。

由来不明の石碑には、ある秘められた場所を示す
手がかりが刻みこまれているとか。

石碑の謎を解き明かせるか、知恵を試してみてはいかがだろう。

洞窟はかつて子供の遊び場になっていたこともあり
危険な場所ではないとのことだ。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
Mystery Stele in Ruby Cave

You’ll find Ruby Cave in the mountains to the south of Olderion, but despite the alluring name, there are no precious stones to be found there.

There is one point of interest, however: the mysterious stele found within the cave.

None know where it came from, but it is said its engravings point the way to a hidden location.

Are you sharp enough to uncover the secret?

In times past, children even played in the cave, so it’s said to not be dangerous to visit.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
Mystery Stele in Ruby Cave

Ruby Cave lies in the mountains south of Olderion. Despite its beautiful name, it has no notable attractions or products to speak of.

There is one point of interest, however: the mysterious stele found within the cave.

None know where it came from, but it is said its engravings point the way to a hidden location.

Are you sharp enough to uncover the secret?

In times past, children even played in the cave, so it's said to not be dangerous to visit.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―腕利きの武器職人求む！―

俺たちのゾルダードで、一緒に戦ってくれる同志を募っている。

なんの戦いだって？

これは自由のための戦いだ。

俺たちには優秀な武器職人が必要だ。
この記事に多くは書けない。だが、武器をつくって
その商流を知っているお前になら、わかるだろ？

戦争を止めたいなら連絡をくれ。

合言葉は「のばら」だ。

広告主：J
text.official_en:
Weapons Wanted!

Here in Zoldaad, we’re lookin’ for folks to join us in the fight. The fight for what, you ask?

Freedom, my brothers and sisters.

What we really need is a top-notch weaponsmith. Can’t go into details, but if you know how to make and distribute weapons, we could use you.

If you want to prevent a full-blown war, that is.

The password is “Wild Rose.”

-J
text.real_en:
—Skilled Weaponsmith Wanted!—

Here in Zoldaad, we're looking for comrades to fight alongside us.

What's the fight for, you ask?

Freedom.

We need a skilled weaponsmith. I can't write much here, but if you make weapons and know how they're traded, you know what I mean, right?

If you want to stop the war, get in touch.

The password is “Wild Rose.”

Advertiser: J

text.jp:
―誰か、雪女と話してきてください―

ミシディアの南西にある小島に住まう雪女が
最近活発に活動しているようです。

飛空艇が上空を飛ぶときに、
妙な冷気が発生していると、外の世界で話題になっています。

放っておけば、ミシディアの発見につながる恐れがあります。
伝承保護人として、危険な兆候と見ます。

雪女はああ見えて、実は、優男に弱いので
容姿に自身のあるものは話をしてきてください。

氷漬けにされても保証はできませんが。

伝承保護人：シュワルツ
text.official_en:
Will Anyone Speak with the Snow Woman?

The “snow woman” who resides on a small island southwest of Mysidia has drawn attention of late.

All over the world, people speak of a strange chill that occurs when flying through her airspace.
At this rate, Mysidia itself may be discovered. As guardian of its legend, I believe this bodes ill.

Despite her fearsome appearance, she has a weakness for handsome men.
If you have confidence in your charms, please go and talk to her.

Just remember to stay warm.

-Schwartz, Guardian of Lore
text.real_en:
Will Anyone Speak with the Snow Woman?

The “snow woman” who resides on a small island southwest of Mysidia has drawn attention of late.

All over the world, people speak of a strange chill that occurs when flying through her airspace.
At this rate, Mysidia itself may be discovered. As guardian of its legend, I believe this bodes ill.

Despite her fearsome appearance, she has a weakness for handsome men.
If you have confidence in your charms, please go and talk to her.

But we can't guarantee you won't end up frozen solid.

-Schwartz, Guardian of Lore

text.jp:
―謎めいた宮殿、主の正体は―

港町グランポートのほど近くに、いわくありげな宮殿がたたずむ。
読者諸氏の中にも、知る者が多いだろう。

今回、ドルフォクシータイムズで取材をしたところ、
宮殿の主は「姫」を名乗っているようだ。
しかし、どこの国の姫なのかはハッキリとしない。

もちろん、グランシェルトに現在、姫はいない。

我々取材班は首を傾げながらも、取材を続けた。

彼女は「石板のカケラ」という貴重品を収拾しているようだ。
もし「石板のカケラ」を持っていたら、ぜひ立ち寄ってほしい。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
Mystery Palace Holds Mystery Princess

Near Grandport looms a particularly conspicuous palace. Perhaps you, dear reader, know it well.

The Drofox Gazette investigated, and we found it to be inhabited by someone claiming to be a princess. But princess of what?

Grandshelt has no princess at present.

Dubious as her claims may be, our duty is to report, not editorialize.

The so-called princess is collecting “tablet shards.” If you have any in your possession, a visit might be in order.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
—The Mysterious Palace: Who Is Its Owner?—

Near the port town of Grandport stands a palace shrouded in mystery. Many of our readers probably know of it.

After investigating for the Drofox Gazette, we learned that the palace’s occupant apparently calls herself a “princess.” But we still don’t know which country she comes from.

Grandshelt, of course, currently has no princess.

Puzzled, we pressed on with our investigation.

It seems she is collecting valuable items known as “tablet shards.” If you have any, do pay her a visit.

Reporter: Foxie

text.jp:
―警告！　龍のアギトに入るべからず―

ファルム王国の最南端に、龍のアギトと呼ばれる洞窟がある。

通常ここに行くような用事はないはずであるが、
意図せず迷い込むようなこともあるかもしれないため
ここに警告を出しておく。

この洞窟の奥に踏み込んだ者はことごとく消息を絶ち、
生きて戻った者はいない。

極めて危険な魔物が棲息するものと考えられる。

命が惜しくば、立ち入らぬよう、強く警告する！

ファルム王国　行政官
text.official_en:
Beware of Dragon’s Maw!

At the southern tip of the Kingdom of Pharm lies a cavern known as Dragon’s Maw.

Most will have no cause to visit such a place, but we issue this warning nonetheless.

All who enter this cavern vanish without a trace; not a single soul has ever returned alive.

We suspect it is home to some manner of fearsome monster.

Stay clear if you value your lives!

-Kingdom of Pharm Official
text.real_en:
Warning! Do Not Enter Dragon’s Maw!

At the southern tip of the Kingdom of Pharm lies a cavern known as Dragon’s Maw.

Most will have no cause to visit such a place, but we issue this warning nonetheless.

Everyone who has ventured deep into the cave has disappeared, and no one has returned alive.

We suspect it is home to some manner of fearsome monster.

Stay clear if you value your lives!

-Kingdom of Pharm Official

text.jp:
―雷鳴山にとどろく稲光、それは裁きの雷か―

ディルマギアの北方にそびえる雷鳴山。
ディルマギア大陸を覆い、外敵を寄せ付けぬ自然の要害だ。

雷鳴がとどろく山道を、落雷におびえて歩く間、
知らず知らずのうちに、古き伝承を口ずさんでいた。

“雷、鳴り止まぬ雷鳴山。それは自然のとどろきか、裁きの雷か”

伝承の意味を考えながら歩むうち、いつしか峠を越えていた。

道中、古の石碑を見つけたが、別の山道からしか辿り着けないようだ。

取材のため先を急ぐ必要があり、心残りだが雷鳴山を後にした。
伝承の意味を解き明かすために、また訪れたいと思う。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
Does Judgment Roll Down from on High?

Towering above northern Dilmagia, Mt. Thunderclap provides a natural deterrent for would-be invaders of the continent.

As I traversed the thunderous mountain path, fearing I might be struck down at any moment, I found myself recalling an old saying:

“The peals that resound from Mt. Thunderclap—are they the cries of nature, or the echoes of judgment?”

While pondering those words, I soon found myself across the mountain pass.

In my crossing I had spied an old stele, but it was unreachable from the path I was on.

With another assignment awaiting, I had no choice but to press on, but I should like to return and uncover the mountain’s secrets.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
Does Judgment Roll Down from on High?

Towering above northern Dilmagia, Mt. Thunderclap provides a natural deterrent for would-be invaders of the continent.

As I traversed the thunderous mountain path, fearing I might be struck down at any moment, I found myself recalling an old saying:

“The peals that resound from Mt. Thunderclap—are they the cries of nature, or the echoes of judgment?”

While pondering those words, I soon found myself across the mountain pass.

In my crossing I had spied an old stele, but it seems accessible only by taking another mountain path.

With another assignment awaiting, I had no choice but to press on, but I should like to return and uncover the mountain’s secrets.

-Foxie

text.jp:
―非道！　ガベラダを襲う剣士！―

ガベラダで事件が起きた！

先日、ガベラダを襲った剣士がいたようである。

目撃者によると、剣士は長老の命よりも大切なものを破壊した上、
現在も逃走中だということだ。

かなりの凶悪犯ではないか、ということで、
ガベラダの宿屋に目撃者たちが集まり対策を練っている。

我こそはこの非道な犯人を捕まえてやろうという者は、
ガベラダの宿屋に行ってみて欲しい！

泣くな、おばば！　誰かがきっと解決してくれるはずだ！！

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
Depraved Swordsman Attacks Gaberada!

A most disturbing incident has occurred in Gaberada.

According to witnesses, a swordsman descended upon the town.

He destroyed a possession of the elder’s more precious than life itself, then fled the scene.

Witnesses have gathered at the inn in Gaberada to plan how to catch the culprit.

If you think you have what it takes to bring this ne’er-do-well to justice, make haste to Gaberada’s inn!

Fear not, Grandma! Help is surely on the way!

-Foxie
text.real_en:
Depraved Swordsman Attacks Gaberada!

A most disturbing incident has occurred in Gaberada.

According to witnesses, a swordsman descended upon the town.

He destroyed something the elder valued more than life itself and is reportedly still on the run.

Witnesses have gathered at the inn in Gaberada to plan how to catch the culprit.

If you think you have what it takes to bring this ne’er-do-well to justice, make haste to Gaberada’s inn!

Fear not, Grandma! Help is surely on the way!

-Foxie

text.jp:
―魚よりうまい！　プリプリ肉発売開始！―

オルデリオンといえば、新鮮な魚！

いえいえもう、そんな時代は古い！

これからの名物はプリプリ肉！

トレビア～ンなプリプリ肉！
家族といっしょにプリプリ肉！
チョコボもおいしくプリプリ肉！

プリティでプリミティブなプリプリ肉！
プリプリ！　プリプリ！　食卓にどうぞ！

広告主：プリプリ商会
text.official_en:
Forget About Fish! Get Some Mushy Meat!

Everyone knows Olderion has the freshest fish around!

But quit living in the past!

Mushy Meat is the wave of the future!

Mushy Meat, c’est magnifique! Feed it to your family! Feed it to your chocobo!

Mushy and meaty, it’s Mushy Meat! Mushy Meat: <text style="italic">it’s what’s for dinner.</>

-The Mushy Company
text.real_en:
Forget About Fish! Get Some Mushy Meat!

Everyone knows Olderion has the freshest fish around!

But quit living in the past!

Mushy Meat is the wave of the future!

Delicious Mushy Meat! Enjoy it with your family! Even your chocobo will love it!

Pretty, primitive Mushy Meat! Mushy, mushy! Put it on your dinner table!

-The Mushy Company

text.jp:
世界各地での取材を経て、私には一つの絶望と一つの希望がある。

絶望は、世界に大きな厄災が起きるかもしれないこと。
クリスタルを壊す勢力の実在は、憶測の域を出て確信に変わった。

だが……その勢力に抗おうと立ち向かう者たちの姿も、各地の噂には刻まれている。

私は記者だ。君たちが世界を救うために戦っていることはわかる。

そう、君たちは――
ナシャトの町の人々を解放し、ドワーフたちを助け、オルデリオンを水没から守り、
そして、このゾルダードの革命を成功に導いた。

君たちは、今も戦っているんだろう？
誰にも見えない場所で。誰もが恐れる存在を相手にして。

……ならば、私はペンを取ろう。君たちの存在を、広めるために。
世界の最果てで戦う君に、私たちの祈りが届くことを信じて。

記者：フォクシー
text.official_en:
My travels far and wide have left me with both hope and despair.

I despair for our world, for we face—not a rumor, but the reality—
of the dreadful force destroying the Crystals.

Yet everywhere I went, there were whispers of a group that stood in opposition.

I know that you’re out there now—fighting to save the world.

You freed the people of Felicitas, saved the dwarves, and delivered Olderion from a deluge.
You even spurred a revolution here in Zoldaad.

And you’re still fighting the good fight, against the most fearsome foe imaginable.

I must do my part too and spread the word. I only pray my message reaches you at the edge of the world.

-Foxie
text.real_en:
My reporting around the world has given me one reason for despair and one for hope.

I despair at the thought that a great calamity may befall the world. What began as speculation has become certainty: a force that destroys Crystals truly exists.

But... stories from all over also tell of people who have stood up to oppose that force.

I’m a reporter. I know you’re fighting to save the world.

That’s right. You freed the people of Felicitas, helped the dwarves, saved Olderion from being flooded, and led the revolution here in Zoldaad to success.

You’re still fighting now, aren’t you? Somewhere no one can see you, against something everyone fears.

...Then I’ll take up my pen and tell the world about you.

I believe our prayers will reach you as you fight at the farthest ends of the world.

Reporter: Foxie
